description: This file implements a socket factory for port range management in WebRTC streaming, including functions to intersect port ranges and create UDP and TCP sockets within specified port ranges.

classes.name: PortRangeSocketFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating UDP and TCP sockets within specified port ranges, handling port range intersection logic.

methods.name: IntersectPortRanges
methods.description: A helper function to compute the intersection of two port ranges, returning a valid range or the full range if no specific range is requested.

methods.name: PortRangeSocketFactory::PortRangeSocketFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the socket factory with specific UDP and TCP port ranges.

methods.name: PortRangeSocketFactory::CreateUdpSocket
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket within the intersected port range, or returns nullptr if no intersection exists.

methods.name: PortRangeSocketFactory::CreateServerTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCP server socket within the intersected port range, or returns nullptr if no intersection exists.
